description: Tailwind CSS build and theming gotchas

entries.bad_pattern: A tailwind.config.cjs color alpha() helper doing arithmetic (opacityValue * 100) on Tailwind's opacity placeholder, emitting color-mix(... NaN%)
entries.good_pattern: In alpha helpers, only emit color-mix() when opacityValue is a real number < 1; otherwise return plain var(--token)
entries.description: Tailwind passes a placeholder STRING (e.g. var(--tw-bg-opacity)) — not a number — to custom color functions for base utilities. Multiplying it yields NaN, producing color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) NaN%, transparent), which is invalid CSS: browsers silently DROP the whole declaration and the element falls back to default white/black. Symptom: pages look half-themed ("both dark and bright"), because hand-written var() CSS works while every Tailwind token utility (bg-bg, text-ink-*, border-line) is dead. Found 2026-06-12 after a tailwind.css rebuild. Also note: chromium --force-prefers-color-scheme is a no-op in some builds; use --blink-settings=preferredColorScheme=1 for light-mode headless screenshots.
entries.context: tailwind.config.cjs custom color definitions; any prebuilt tailwind.css rebuild
